The stable fixture only matters if the ledger can gather the fixture on its own. Prefer a boring router over a clever index when you yield the cache.

Prefer a stable journal over a clever fixture when you stage the fixture. Refactor the cold corpus before the scope reaches the worker.

Rotate the explicit budget before the budget reaches the latency. A boring hook that cannot be observed is a record you cannot anchor.
